settings.headline: You hire me. You get me.
settings.body:
I am Elena Marlowe, a licensed architect in Austin. I take four to six houses, ADUs and remodels a year, and I am the person at every meeting, on every site visit, and behind every drawing.

No hand-offs to a junior team. No wondering who designed your kitchen. More about me.

settings.headline: Four phases, one architect
settings.intro: A written scope, drawings in stages, and a client portal where every decision lives.

items.title: Walk and talk
items.text: We walk your land or house together. I listen, measure the light, and tell you honestly what I would do.

items.title: Design
items.text: Sketches, models and plans in stages. You comment in your portal; nothing moves on undecided.

items.title: Permits and builder
items.text: Construction drawings, city and county permits, and help choosing a builder whose work I know.

items.title: Build and after
items.text: Site visits at the moments that matter, weekly written updates, and a walk together at move-in.

settings.quote: Elena walked the land four times before she drew a line. The house sits exactly where she stood, and it stays cool at six in August.
settings.name: Karen Andersen
settings.role: Homeowner, Live Oak Ridge House, Dripping Springs (fictional)

settings.headline: Have a lot, a house, or just an idea?
settings.text: Start with a free 30-minute conversation. I will tell you what I would do next — even if the answer is not to hire me. This demo has no forms; the button goes to the contact page.
